AGI.name: AGI Greenpac Limited
AGI.moat: One of India's largest container-glass and specialty-packaging makers (glass bottles for liquor, beer, food, pharma and cosmetics) with a growing premium/specialty glass, caps-&-closures and PET business. Capital-intensive furnaces and premium-glass (spirits/perfume) capability give some differentiation in an otherwise cyclical, energy-heavy industry.
AGI.leadership: Among the top-2 container-glass producers in India (Somany/HSIL lineage); expanding specialty glass and closures, and pursued the HNG insolvency acquisition to consolidate share.
AGI.non_rep: Glass furnaces are capital- and energy-intensive with long build times; premium/specialty glass approvals (spirits, perfume) and closures capability create moderate switching friction.

ASAHIINDIA.name: Asahi India Glass Limited
ASAHIINDIA.moat: India's largest integrated glass company and the dominant automotive-glass supplier (~70% OEM share) with decades-long approvals at Maruti Suzuki, Hyundai and others, plus a large architectural/float-glass business. Backed by AGC (Asahi Glass, Japan) technology and a Maruti/Suzuki shareholding.
ASAHIINDIA.leadership: #1 in Indian auto glass with an entrenched OEM position; integrated float-to-value-added glass and a growing architectural/consumer (AIS Windows) franchise.
ASAHIINDIA.non_rep: Auto glass is a certification-gated, model-life-locked business; OEM co-development and single/dual-source approvals plus AGC technology and float integration are extremely hard to replicate.
tailwinds: China+1 / import substitution in float glass

MMFL.name: M M Forgings Limited
MMFL.moat: Chennai-based maker of steel forgings and machined components (crankshafts, front-axle beams, connecting rods) for commercial vehicles, tractors and off-highway, with a large export franchise (US/Europe). Scale forging capacity plus in-house machining and long OEM relationships give a mid-tier cost/quality edge.
MMFL.leadership: Among India's larger CV/off-highway forging exporters; integrated forging + machining with a diversified global customer base and acquired overseas capacity.
MMFL.non_rep: Forging dies, metallurgical process control and multi-year OEM/Tier-1 approvals for safety-critical drivetrain parts create switching friction, though the product is cyclical and competitive.
track: EBITDA margin & leverage through the cycle
